theme: Light mode dominant (bright, clean educational look) with high contrast.

headings.usage: Use for H1-H4. Max size text-6xl on desktop. NEVER use Inter.

data_and_math.usage: Graphs axes, AI Tutor equations, live slider values.

rules: No pure black (#000000) or gray without tint. Neutral grays must have a slight blue tint.
Primary color ONLY for CTAs, active sliders, and primary interaction points.
Hover states must be a lighter hue of the active state. Explicitly set text color on hover.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Crisp solid cards with 'border-black/5' or 'border-border'. Avoid heavy glassmorphism for data clarity. Use Neumorphic principles lightly for toggles.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft ambient shadows for cards: shadow-sm or shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]. For active dragged elements: shadow-lg.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid crisp borders everywhere to separate content cleanly. Radius: rounded-xl for main containers, rounded-md for inner elements.

layouts.global: Role-based progressive disclosure dashboard. Left sidebar navigation, top header with user context.
layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, and p-12 for container padding. Internal card padding p-6 minimum.
layouts.virtual_lab: Split pane layout. Left: Canvas (col-span-1 lg:col-span-8). Right: Controls/Sliders (col-span-1 lg:col-span-4).
layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid. Base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gap: gap-6.

components.name: Sliders
components.instructions: Use Shadcn Slider, heavily customized for 'Vibrant Play' with thick primary colored tracks and large easy-to-grab thumbs.

components.name: Cards
components.instructions: Go cardless or use strictly rectangular, flat backgrounds with 1px borders and subtle shadow.

components.name: Buttons
components.instructions: Pill-shaped or rounded-md. Include hover transforms (-translate-y-[1px]) and clear focus rings.

components.name: Interactive Canvas
components.instructions: Must have a 'blueprint' or 'grid paper' background pattern (using CSS background size/image) to reinforce the physics/engineering feel.

rules: Real-time feedback is critical: Sliders must instantly update the canvas and graph without lag.
Staggered entrance animations for dashboard cards (framer-motion).
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='sim-play-button').
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text.
Focus states must have a high contrast 2px ring.

media.icons: lucide-react (crisp, simple, well-supported). Use consistent stroke width.
media.illustrations: SVG graphics for physics concepts. Use clean vector art.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion and standard HTML5 Canvas/SVG for 2D Mechanics MVP (pendulums, springs, projectiles) to ensure absolute 60fps real-time sync with sliders.
3d_libraries.charts: Recharts for Graph Studio (Position/Velocity/Acceleration vs Time).
3d_libraries.math: MathJax or react-katex for AI Tutor equations and LaTeX rendering.

virtual_lab_empty_state.description: Student working on a circuit board. Use for 'Virtual Lab' onboarding or empty states.

notes_and_study.description: Student writing in book. Use for 'Notes' or 'Teacher Studio' sections.

physics_universe_hero.description: Floating cubes and glowing spheres. Use for 'Physics Universe' topic explorer background or hero.

mechanics_module_cover.description: Blue and white round abstract illustration. Use for Mechanics topic card.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
File Extensions: Use .js or .jsx for all React components. Do not use .tsx as per environment rules.
DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings. Use Outfit or Cabinet Grotesk.
Avoid generic centered layouts. Use grid/bento layouts with asymmetric spans.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (e.g., p-8, p-12).
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Use recharts for plotting real-time physics data.
Ensure the physics simulation canvas acts in real-time with sliders (controlled via state).
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute.
DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in header/overlays. Always have a solid or highly opaque blurred background.
